{{Quote|They rebel to become the navy we've prayed for. They have come to save us. But first, we must save them.|Gial Ackbar, to [[Alliance Military|Rebel Alliance forces]]|<ref name="SW 49" />}}
The '''Mutiny on Mon Cala''' was a rebellion in which the [[Mon Calamari]] rose up against the [[Galactic Empire]]'s occupation of their planet. In 1 ABY, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] sent [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and the [[Heroes of Yavin]] to [[Mon Cala]] to recruit the [[Mon Cala Mercantile Fleet]] to their [[Galactic Civil War|cause]]. They succeeded, but the fleet was forced to fight against an Imperial Blockade to escape Mon Cala.

==Prelude==
===Failed Negotiations===
Following an [[Invasion of Mon Cala|Imperial invasion]], during the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|early reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[water]] [[planet]] of [[Mon Cala]] fell under [[Occupation of Mon Cala|Imperial occupation]]<ref name="Dark Lord 17">[[Darth Vader (2017) 17|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 17]]</ref> Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin]], [[Han Solo]], [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], [[Gial Ackbar]], [[Luke Skywalker]], [[C-3PO]], [[Chewbacca]], and [[R2-D2]] traveled to an atoll on Mon Cala to meet with [[Regent]] [[Dors Urtya]], [[Grand Admiral]] of the [[Mon Cala Mercantile Fleet]]. They discussed recruiting the fleet to the Rebel cause and starting an uprising against the Imperial occupation, but were interrupted by a [[squad]] of [[stormtrooper]]s in a [[LAAT/le patrol gunship]] that destroyed Urtya's ship. Han Solo [[Death|killed]] many of them with a [[thermal detonator]], but the surviving [[troop]]s pursued the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebels]] into a nearby [[jungle]]. The Rebels, fortunately, managed to escape by boat.

Fearing the consequences the people of his world might face, Urtya declined to provide the Rebellion with the fleet's aid in [[Galactic Civil War|their war against]] [[Galactic Empire|the Empire]]. Disappointed, the rebels returned to the [[Mako-Ta Space Docks]] to report to [[Mon Mothma]] and [[Jan Dodonna]].<ref name="SW 44" /> Refusing to give up on the Mon Calamari fleet, Leia Organa proposed to [[Alliance High Command]] that they free the [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] [[King of Mon Cala|King]] [[Lee-Char]] from the [[Unidentified Imperial base (Strokill Prime)|Imperial base]] on [[Strokill Prime]]. After some debate, the plan was approved. Rebel forces then traveled to the [[Dex Acquisitions Depot]] prison on [[Meor Ain]] to free [[Tunga Arpagion]], a [[Clawdite]] [[Changeling|shapeshifter]], to aid their effort.<ref name="SW 45" />

===Kidnapping of Moff Hubi===
Returning to Mon Cala, Rebel forces infiltrated the [[Moncaladrome]] opera house by disguising Luke Skywalker as a stormtrooper, while C-3PO and R2-D2 pretended to be caterers and Han an attendant. R2-D2 gave [[Moff]] [[Tan Hubi]] an accelerator, his favorite beverage, and waited for him to use the [[refresher]]. When he did so, Han Solo and Chewbacca kidnapped the Moff and replaced him with Tunga Arpagion, who imitated the Moff's appearance. 

===Infiltration of Strokill Prime===
Leia Organa and a small team took the real Hubi to the base on Strokill Prime, where she used codes provided by Queen Trios of Shu-Torun alongside Hubi's biosignature to bypass the base's defenses.<ref name="SW 46" /> After evading a giant fish, the Rebel team successfully infiltrated the prison. They located King Lee-Char but found him barely alive, attached to a [[life support]] system.<ref name="SW 47">[[Star Wars (2015) 47|''Star Wars'' (2015) 47]]</ref> Moff Hubi then managed to get in contact with Imperial Forces and reveal that he had been kidnapped and replaced with an impersonator. 

In the Moncaladrome, stormtroopers opened fire on the false Moff, but the Rebel forces managed to escape. In the prison on Strokill Prime, King Lee-Char recorded a speech to be played for his people, but was cut off when Stormtroopers entered the room and opened fire, killing Lee-Char. Moff Hubi was caught in the crossfire and died as well. The Rebel team fought their way out and returned to Mon Cala, meeting up with C-3PO, R2-D2, and Tunga.<ref name="SW 48" />

==The Mon Calamari Uprising==
The Rebels attempted to broadcast Lee-Char's recording to the Mon Calamari fleet, but found themselves surrounded by Regent Urtya's Guards. The Mon Calamari Regent took the recording of Lee-Char's final moments, only to decide to broadcast it to the Mon Calamari fleet himself. Inspired by Lee-Char's words, the Mon Calamari rose up against the Imperial forces. They attempted to escape the system, joined by the [[Millennium Falcon]], but five [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyers]] suddenly entered the system.<ref name="SW 48" /> 

The Star Destroyers deployed several [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE bombers]] to destroy the fleet, which lacked any weaponry and could only watch as the deadly fighters approached. Fortunately, Rebel Admiral Gial Ackbar arrived with squadrons of [[T-65B X-wing starfighter|X-wings]] and [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber|Y-wings]] as backup, defending the fleet from the bombers. Despite Ackbar's reinforcements, the Rebel fleet remained outmatched and trapped, until [[Pysk Lila]], captain of the ''[[Aurora Flare]]'', came up with a plan. Her ship was loaded with a shipment of extremely explosive coaxium.

Lila piloted the ''Flare'' towards the Imperial blockade, which the Imperial forces believed was merely a desperate last resort. The Star Destroyers fired on the ''Flare,'' realizing too late that it carried a volatile payload that would punch a hole in the blockade. Imperial Admiral Tyrus Meori ordered his ships to stop firing and take evasive action, but the order was not relayed in time to prevent the ''Aurora Flare'' from exploding catastrophically. The blast threw the Imperial forces into chaos and allowed the Mon Cala Mercantile Fleet to escape.

After the Rebels escaped, the Imperial Star Destroyers commenced an orbital bombardment on Regent Urtya's headquarters, killing him.<ref name="SW 49" />

==Aftermath==
Although Urtya lost his life, Lee-Char's message of rebellion had successfully been transmitted, and the Rebel Alliance had secured a fleet.<ref name="SW 49" /> The Imperial occupation of Mon Cala would eventually be broken when the [[Quarren]] and Mon Calamari joined together, wiping out the Empire's [[garrison]] on their homeworld together.<ref name="BMF 24">{{BuildFalconCite|24|Starship Fact File}}</ref>
